## What is Vitamin K2?  
[Vitamin K2](https://www.plantextractwholesale.com/product/vitamin-k2-manufacturers-suppliers.html) is a fat-soluble vitamin that is essential for maintaining bone health and normal blood clotting. It exists primarily in various forms known as menaquinones, the most common of which are MK-4 and MK-7. [Vitamin K2](https://www.plantextractwholesale.com/product/vitamin-k2-manufacturers-suppliers.html) plays a key role in regulating calcium metabolism, helping to ensure that calcium is efficiently transported and utilized in bone tissue rather than accumulating in arteries and other soft tissues.

## Sources of Vitamin K2  
[Vitamin K2](https://www.plantextractwholesale.com/product/vitamin-k2-manufacturers-suppliers.html) is primarily found in fermented foods, such as natto, hard cheese, and fermented soy products. Human gut microbes can also produce small amounts of [Vitamin K2](https://www.plantextractwholesale.com/product/vitamin-k2-manufacturers-suppliers.html). Commercially, [Vitamin K2](https://www.plantextractwholesale.com/product/vitamin-k2-manufacturers-suppliers.html) can be produced by bacterial fermentation or synthetic methods.
## Benefits of Vitamin K2  
Strengthen bones: Improve bone density and prevent osteoporosis.  
Protect cardiovascular system: reduce arteriosclerosis and protect heart health.  
Promotes blood health: Supports normal blood clotting process and prevents bleeding.
